propositions: Two JSON-format derived files (index.json and criterion-pins.json) lack self-identifying markers because JSON has no comment syntax, making it easy for authors to edit the generated artifact instead of its source, triggering drift gate failures and wasted CI cycles
A new top-level _generated_by field must be added to both JSON files and emitted by their generators as a fixed point so regeneration reproduces markers byte-for-byte and the drift gate passes

Two existing tests (test_index_on_disk_matches_regenerated and test_user_write_does_not_change_committed_index) must be updated to compare against the marker-bearing build_index_document() output rather than the pure build_prompt_index() builder
load_catalog() must skip underscore-prefixed keys so the _generated_by marker never becomes a phantom reviewer and catalog consumers are unaffected

A new docs/README.md table must enumerate all nine derived and parity-gated surfaces with their sources, regenerate commands, and enforcing CI gates, explicitly flagging three hand-authored-but-gated surfaces as NOT to be bannered

A new test must verify that the docs/README.md table row set exactly matches the canonical registry of derived surfaces, and that each generated file carries its marker, causing staleness to be caught at test time
